verification.pdf_assertion_resolution: Require the actual uppercase pillar labels and capitalized Independent review-status label; retain all seven disclosure requirements. Each missing disclosure has a negative regression case.
verification.artifact_browser_resolution: The verifier reused a document after a different CSP-bearing card. That prior CSP blocked the next stylesheet, yielding 3405px width at a 390px viewport. Fresh document isolation fixes the verifier without changing either artifact or CSP.
verification.artifact_content_changes: none; all six teaching-card/source-map artifacts byte-identical
verification.scope_limit: Local supplied-HTML and separate loopback HTTP tests. Not full browser/server integration, real-device/assistive-technology evaluation, educator approval or learning-effectiveness evidence.

verification.failure: New PDF text assertion expects title-case pillar labels; rendered PDF uses uppercase. Preserved, not suppressed.
verification.artifact_browser_failure: Expanded source-map HTML has horizontal overflow at 390 px; later checks not completed.
